title: Private Idol Disc: Tokubetsu-hen: Can Gal '97
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ 【特別編】 キャンペーン・ガール’９７
overview:
A treasure trove of future idols and actresses!! A database software of campaign girls

Rapidly rising campaign girls appear!! Which of them will break out...!?

This special edition of the Private Idol Disc series is a digital photo book and database of the 1997 campaign girls. Browse each woman's profile and photo gallery in the Data Hall, then test what you have learned in a multiple-choice quiz about the girls.

- Data Hall: cast profiles and photos
- Mini game: Can Gal Quiz
- Production credits
